title: Concealed Poison Dart Trap
description: A pressure plate hidden beneath loose dungeon flagstones. Stepping on it launches poisoned iron darts from the wall.

title: Glyph of Warding (Explosive Runes)
description: An arcane glyph inscribed upon the stonework. When triggered, it erupts in a magical blast of fire.

title: Concealed Spike Pit
description: A false stone floor covering a ten-foot pit lined with sharpened iron spikes.

title: Corrosive Acid Spray Trap
description: A pressurized glass vial rigged to a chest lock. Tampering without disarming releases pressurized corrosive acid.
